title: moraea autumnalis
intro: Moraea autumnalis, commonly known as autumn leek, is a plant species belonging to the Iridaceae family. It is traditionally used to support respiratory health, particularly in the treatment of bronchitis, and is valued for its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of autumn leek include its ability to relieve coughs, soothe sore throats, and ease congestion, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Moraea autumnalis include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
